messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@olivehealth.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 17:12:00 -0000
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & next steps — Olive Health assessment

Hi Sarah / Rajesh —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap + proposed mutual action plan so we have aligned owners and dates. Please review and flag any changes.

Summary of pain points you described:
- Spiky inference latency during peak patient lookups (~300ms SLA target, currently 700-900ms).
- High per-token costs on current setup; need predictable unit economics for production.
- Compliance: must demonstrate SOC2 controls, audit logs, and strict data retention rules.
- Integration: want a straightforward path to run model inference inside their VPC for PHI-sensitive flows.

High-level goals:
1) Prove we can meet 300ms p95 for the primary retrieval+prompt pattern.
2) Reduce per-token cost by >=30% vs their current managed endpoint.
3) Validate security posture for Private deployment (audit logs/KMS).

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (editable):
- Milestone A — PoC environment & access: Redwood spins up a dedicated test environment in Olive Health region (sandbox). Target owner: Redwood (Sergio) — target date: 2026-03-10.
- Milestone B — Performance benchmark run (latency & throughput): Redwood to run synthetic + replay tests, deliver report. Owner: Monica (CS) — target date: 2026-03-24.
- Milestone C — Security evidence handoff: SOC2 summary, retention controls, key management docs delivered to Olive. Owner: Redwood Security (Priyom) — target date: 2026-03-17.
- Milestone D — Procurement & commercial review: Olive procurement & legal to confirm terms; target date: 2026-04-01.
- Decision Point — Go/No-Go for production pilot. Olive decision owner: Rajesh / Lina — target date: 2026-04-15.

Open questions / asks for Olive:
1) Confirm the internal stakeholders (procurement/contact) — I noted Lina Ortiz for procurement and Rajesh as engineering decision owner.
2) Share any compliance questionnaire (we can attach evidence) — I’ve attached a placeholder security questionnaire for now.
3) Availability for a technical deep-dive (30–45m) — I proposed Wed, 2026-03-03 10:00am PT.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx, redwood-sla-overview.pdf (draft timelines and SLA language).

If that looks right, I’ll update the map and circulate a v2 with confirmed owners/dates and a calendar invite for Mar 3 technical deep-dive.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

- Dates: Mar 10 PoC env works for us. For the performance benchmark, can we move the target to 2026-03-26? We have a compliance blackout week the week of Mar 22 and want the report after that.
- Procurement: Confirming Lina Ortiz (cc’d) will own procurement and licensing discussions. Lina, welcome — can you share your standard SLAs/term redlines we should anticipate?
- Security: I’ve attached our internal security questionnaire (partial) — you should be able to respond to the items marked high priority. SOC2 attestation is required.
- Technical deep-dive: Mar 3 at 10:00am PT works for Rajesh and me. Please send an invite.

One more item: we have a separate team handling PHI ingress. They’ll need details about network setup for the Private option. Rajesh, I’ll loop them into the technical call if needed.

Thanks,
